static_traits.name: Lin Wei
static_traits.family_status: Lives with wife; wife works in hairdressing
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends, usually discussing everyday matters, but not yet discussed financial insecurity with them
static_traits.medical_history: without significant physical illness;not yet received psychotherapy or counseling before; experienced financial stress in the past but with mild impact
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperation; tone neutral leaning anxious and pessimistic; often uses absolute statements (like 'never will be happy'); thinking prone to comparison and catastrophizing, jumping to conclusions; marked Self-denial

basic_info.main_problem: I feel that due to our financial situation, my wife and I will never feel happy about life, which leads to dissatisfaction and a sense of despair.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent dissatisfaction and sense of despair have seriously affected our mental health and relationship, prompting me to seek counseling; hoping to explore managing and restructuring these thoughts to improve overall well-being.
growth_experiences: Years ago, sudden unexpected expenses triggered long-term financial struggle, with extremely high initial stress leading to Relationship tension; since then often comparing self with more stable others who enjoy luxuries and vacations (especially seeing friends' vacations or new items on social media), with negative emotions recurring; although trying budgeting and cutting expenses, dissatisfaction and despair still often flare up again.

core_beliefs: Happiness depends on money and material things
I am not good enough(unable to provide and enjoy like others)

special_situations.event: Sees friends posting luxury goods or vacation photos on social media
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If we cannot enjoy luxuries like others, it means we are failures and will not be happy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discussing financial insecurity with friends, reinforcing thrift and budgeting to prove one can stay in control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: We are not as good as others; we will never be happy

special_situations.event: Unexpected expenses or increased bills arise
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once extra expenses appear, it means we are doomed to never escape this plight
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive worry, extreme spending cuts, and repeated budget checking in pursuit of a sense of security
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is over; we will never turn things around

special_situations.event: Arguing with wife due to financial pressure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If we argue about money, the relationship will only get worse; we are doomed not to be happy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding or shortening in-depth conversations about money, turning to talking only about budgets and numbers to reduce emotional conflict
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Our relationship is going downhill and will not improve

core_conflict.wish: Longs to have a stable, recognized and graspable happy life (sense of security and worth)
core_conflict.fear: Fears poverty and comparison leading to being devalued and seen as a failure, and worsening the partner relationship
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of security through control and rationalized budgeting
Avoiding talking about financial insecurity publicly to avoid being judged
Repressing and downplaying painful emotions to maintain functioning

object_relations.object_representation: Others (friends, society) are the standard-setters of judgment and superiority

object_relations.self_representation: A partner under stress, a bearer striving to maintain the situation
object_relations.object_representation: Wife as an other who is equally anxious and may criticize or conflict with oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing friends' vacations or luxury spending on social media
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others are doing better and judging oneself: we have been left behind, I am a failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplaying emotions, not elaborating, quickly shifting to other topics or practical matters, flat tone, avoiding emotional words.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing finances with his wife and tension or arguments arise
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes talking about emotions will only intensify conflict; only numbers and plans are controllable
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding centered on budgets, expense details, and plans, reducing emotional expression, using objective terms and logical chains.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When change of thinking or trying new methods is mentioned (filled with doubt inside)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feeling the situation has long taken shape and change is not realistic
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing doubt with reasons like 'we have always been this way''reality does not allow it', restrained tone, emphasizing external constraints.

manifestations: Strongly ties happiness to money and material level
Frequently compares with others and sees oneself as a failure
Self-denial and despair intensified by social media triggers
outcomes: Decline in work performance, attention disrupted by Financial worries

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Directly adopting society's material standards of success and happiness as one's own (must be like others to be happy)
Often judges oneself by implicit 'should/must' rules

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Turning comparison results into Self-denial (feeling not good enough, a failure)
Not discussing financial insecurity with friends for fear of being judged

exception_events.target_problem: When seeing others enjoying luxuries or vacations, the client usually catastrophizes and falls into dissatisfaction and despair, leading to Relationship tension and Sleep affected.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In a moment of successfully saving a little money or things going well, the client did not fall into the usual despair but experienced brief hope and ease, with reduced Anxiety intensity.
exception_events.reason: Clues: with visible positive progress (successfully saving a small deposit/things moving as wished) and concrete goals achieved, the sense of control was reinforced; the current trigger was different, negative comparisons decreased, so this time the emotion shifted toward hope.

positive_force: Has proactively made a budget and cut spending, with some foundation of self-management
Occasionally gains hope and a sense of control from small financial progress
Willing to seek help and try cognitive restructuring and behavioral experiments
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking are prominent, often jumping to conclusions (predicting the worst)
Frequently compares with others and measures self-worth materially; strong external validation tendency
Negating positive cues, difficulty sustaining hope
Shame and self-blame about financial topics, avoids seeking support from friends
Ongoing stress leads to Sleep impaired,Relationship tension,Decline in work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic and absolute thinking around finances and happiness (with Anxiety/low mood)
antecedent: Seeing others' luxury or vacations on social media
Unexpected expenses or increased bills arise
Discussing money with the wife and creating tension
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjected standards binding happiness tightly to money and material things, excessive comparison and predicting the worst yet to come; leaning toward negative Anticipation to avoid uncertainty and disappointment.
target_behavior.function: Seeking a sense of control through negative predictions and budget control, reducing Anxiety from uncertainty (avoiding potential disappointment).
target_behavior.consequence: Heightened Anxiety and despair,Sleep affected; partner Relationship tension, more arguments;Decline in work performance.

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding discussing financial insecurity and vulnerability with friends
antecedent: Shame and inferiority when thinking about seeking support from friends
Feeling judged or like a failure after comparing with others
During periods of rising financial stress
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being judged or looked down on (personalization and external-validation tendencies), protecting self-image and relationships through avoidance.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding unwelcome evaluations and embarrassment, temporarily relieving shame and Anxiety.
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient Social support, stress unable to be externalized and shared, maintaining negative thinking and Sense of isolation.
